tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search the EscortFox directory of independent escorts, agencies and venues in one place. Returns up to 20 listing summaries per page: name, location, age, starting rate, verification status, incall/outcall, venue type, a short teaser and the listing's escortfox.com link. tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get the summary of one EscortFox listing by its numeric id — the number at the end of a listing link (…/anna-12345 → 12345). Returns the same fields as search_listings and the listing's escortfox.com link; contact details and photos are only on that page.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List the countries that have active EscortFox listings, with the number of escort and venue listings in each. Use a country code as `country` in list_cities and search_listings.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the cities of a country that have active listings, busiest first, with escort and venue counts and each city's escortfox.com link. Use the city slug as `city` in search_listings, and the city's region as `country` where it differs from the country code (US states, e.g. "US-CA").

tools.name: list_districts
tools.description: List the districts of a city that have active listings (most cities have none). Use a district slug as `district` in search_listings.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the service vocabulary of escort listings (slug and English name). Use a slug as `service` in search_listings (escort searches only).
